YieldPayload.title: Gaiapus yield estimate
YieldPayload.description: Municipal yield at harvest (kg/ha) from data available up to a validated cutoff after sowing. Separate product from the water-risk projection.

sowing_basis.description: Origin of sowing_date. The models were validated on the state calendar; a reported date shifts the features (see calendar sensitivity)

cutoff_days_used.description: Largest validated cutoff not after the requested day

observed_through.description: Last day of data the estimate used

WaterRiskPayload.title: Gaiapus water-risk projection
WaterRiskPayload.description: Soil water, deficit and stress for N days after a decision, driven by the forecast issued before the request. Never converted into a yield effect.

validated_lead.description: False beyond the largest lead that passed the backtest

reference_days.description: Same bucket driven by the 2001-2021 day-of-year climatology, for comparison
